title: Initial Configuration from Empty Tape Words
statement: For any number $k$ of work tapes, state $q$, and Boolean input word $x$, the initial configuration on $x$ with state $q$ equals the configuration formed from $q$ and the family of empty words on all work tapes.
hypotheses_covered: A nonnegative number $k$ of work tapes
